requirement_text: The user shall be able to create a todo item with non-empty text.
The system shall reject creating a todo item when the todo text is empty.
The system shall limit todo text length to 100 characters.
The user shall be able to mark an active todo item as completed.
The user shall be able to mark a completed todo item as active again.
The user shall be able to delete an existing todo item.
The system shall display all todo items in the todo list.
The system shall keep todo items after page refresh.
The user shall be able to create a todo item by pressing Enter.
The system shall trim leading and trailing spaces from todo text.
The system shall reject todo text that contains only spaces.
The system shall show a validation message when todo creation fails.
The system shall allow creating multiple todo items with different text.
The system shall preserve the order in which todo items are created.
The user shall be able to edit the text of an active todo item.
The user shall be able to edit the text of a completed todo item.
The system shall save edited todo text when the user presses Enter.
The system shall cancel editing when the user presses Escape.
The system shall reject edited todo text when it is empty.
The system shall enforce the 100 character limit during todo editing.
The system shall keep the completion status unchanged after editing todo text.
The system shall display updated todo text immediately after saving an edit.
The user shall be able to mark all active todo items as completed.
The user shall be able to mark all completed todo items as active.
The system shall update a todo item state immediately after toggle.
The system shall keep todo item text unchanged after completion toggle.
The system shall update active item count after a todo is completed.
The system shall update active item count after a completed todo becomes active.
The system shall support toggling completion state repeatedly.
The system shall display completed todo items with a completed visual style.
The user shall be able to delete an active todo item.
The user shall be able to delete a completed todo item.
The system shall remove a deleted todo item from all filter views.
The system shall update todo counts after a todo item is deleted.
The system shall not delete other todo items when one item is deleted.
The system shall allow deleting the last remaining todo item.
The system shall show an empty list state after all todo items are deleted.
The user shall be able to clear all completed todo items.
The system shall display active todo items without completed styling.
The system shall display completed todo items with completed styling.
The system shall display todo items in creation order by default.
The system shall show an empty state message when no todo items exist.
The system shall hide the todo list container when there are no todo items.
The system shall show the todo list container when at least one item exists.
The system shall display long todo text without breaking the layout.
The system shall preserve readable spacing between todo items.
The user shall be able to view all todo items.
The user shall be able to view only active todo items.
The user shall be able to view only completed todo items.
The system shall keep the selected filter visible to the user.
The system shall update the active filter view after a todo item changes state.
The system shall update the completed filter view after a todo item changes state.
The system shall show an empty filtered view when no item matches the selected filter.
The system shall preserve the selected filter after deleting a todo item.
The system shall display the number of active todo items.
The system shall display zero active items when all todos are completed.
The system shall increase the active count when a new active todo is created.
The system shall decrease the active count when an active todo is completed.
The system shall increase the active count when a completed todo becomes active.
The system shall decrease the active count when an active todo is deleted.
The system shall save todo items to local storage after creation.
The system shall save todo completion state to local storage.
The system shall save edited todo text to local storage.
The system shall remove deleted todo items from local storage.
The system shall restore todo items from local storage on page load.
The system shall restore selected filter state after page refresh.
The system shall handle missing local storage data without crashing.
The system shall handle corrupted local storage data by starting with an empty list.
The system shall reject todo text longer than 100 characters.
The system shall accept todo text with exactly 100 characters.
The system shall accept todo text with exactly 1 character.
The system shall reject todo text with zero characters.
The system shall reject blank todo input after whitespace trimming.
The system shall display a clear error message for invalid todo input.
The system shall remove the validation message after valid input is submitted.
The system shall prevent duplicate submission when the user presses Enter repeatedly.
The user shall be able to select all todo items.
The user shall be able to unselect all todo items.
The user shall be able to delete selected todo items.
The user shall be able to mark selected todo items as completed.
The user shall be able to mark selected todo items as active.
The system shall update counts after bulk operations.
The user shall be able to search todo items by text.
The system shall show matching todo items for a search term.
The system shall show an empty result message when search has no matches.
The system shall perform case insensitive todo search.
The system shall update search results after a todo item is edited.
The system shall clear search results when the search input is cleared.
The user shall be able to focus the todo input using keyboard navigation.
The user shall be able to move focus between todo items using the Tab key.
The user shall be able to toggle a focused todo item using the Space key.
The user shall be able to delete a focused todo item using a keyboard shortcut.
The system shall provide accessible labels for todo input controls.
The system shall expose completion state to screen readers.
The system shall provide sufficient color contrast for todo status indicators.
The system shall keep keyboard focus visible during navigation.
The system shall sanitize todo text before displaying it.
The system shall prevent script execution from todo text.
The system shall not store passwords or credentials in todo text metadata.
The system shall prevent unauthorized access to admin only todo management features.
